title: 第八章 席间藏机锋，宴前暗布局
content_zh:
沈敬山谈起自家女儿连日来的转变，语气里藏着真切的欣慰。往日沈清鸢满心满眼都是太子萧景煜，事事轻信柳氏母女，屡屡行事莽撞，没少让他忧心劳神。可短短几日，少女处事沉稳周全，几番拆破后宅算计，连府中最有威望的老夫人，都事事偏向于她。

    萧聿辞指尖扶着青瓷茶盏，杯中茶汤腾起袅袅白汽，他神色淡然，随口应声：“深闺女子能幡然醒悟、收敛心性，实属难得。”

    短短一句夸赞，直直戳在柳氏心上。她安坐末席，指腹死死绞着随身锦帕，面上还要勉强撑住温婉得体的笑意，心底早已慌乱不安。摄政王权倾朝野，他随口一句品评，便抬高了沈清鸢的身价，往后她再想暗中刁难、设计嫡女，势必多上一重掣肘。

    老夫人将柳氏藏不住的焦灼神色尽收眼底，慢悠悠端茶抿了一口，顺势调转话头，聊起京里世家近期的宴席。她转头看向身侧的沈清鸢，语声平缓：“再过三日便是平宁侯府的海棠宴，你备好衣物前去赴宴，趁着宴席多结识几位世家贵女，拓宽往来。”

    柳氏闻言眼睛一动，立刻起身柔声央求：“老夫人，轻柔前些日子受了惊吓，连日闷在院内静养，心里憋闷不已，不如让她随同清鸢一道赴宴，既能散心，也可帮衬姐姐打理琐事。”她心里打着如意算盘，只要沈轻柔入了海棠宴，便能伺机和太子碰面，按着原定计谋陷害沈清鸢。

    沈清鸢眉眼淡淡，不紧不慢回道：“姨娘体恤妹妹我自然知晓，只是庶妹身子孱弱，方才在花园尚且险些晕厥，侯府宾客云集、路途奔波，万一染了风寒得不偿失。再者侯府请柬只送至我这位嫡女，无帖贸然登门，反倒落得相府失礼的闲话。”

    几句话有理有据，堵得柳氏无言辩驳。沈轻柔立在一旁，眼圈倏地泛红，委屈地攥紧衣角，碍于摄政王在场，不敢哭闹撒泼，只能默默咽下满腹不甘。

    萧聿辞冷眼旁观完这场后宅博弈，深邃目光落向从容镇定的沈清鸢，倏然开口：“本王与平宁侯素来交好，三日本要登门议事，清鸢若是赴宴，顺路由本王车马捎带便可。”

    一语落地，满堂俱静。沈敬山又惊又喜，连连道谢，柳氏脸色瞬间灰白，好不容易筹划的宴席圈套，因摄政王一句话险些全盘落空。

    片刻闲谈过后，萧聿辞起身告辞，沈清鸢奉命随父亲送至府门外。晚风裹挟海棠落花飘落在地，四下只剩二人独处，萧聿辞垂眸看向身侧少女，低沉嗓音伴着晚风响起：“今日相助并非凑巧，我不愿前世那场焚身之祸，再度重演。”

    沈清鸢浑身猛地僵住，抬眼满是错愕。前世葬身火海是她独守的秘密，萧聿辞怎么会知情？不等她追问，男人已然转身，玄色衣袍融进暮色之中。

    回到汀兰院，春桃悄悄来报，柳氏一回院子就写了密信，遣心腹小厮秘密送往东宫。沈清鸢捻起肩头落下的海棠花瓣，眼底寒意渐生，既然柳氏与太子执意要在海棠宴动手，那她便顺水推舟，坐等仇人自投罗网。
content_en:
Shen Jingshan talked about the changes in his daughter in recent days, with real relief in his tone. In the past, Shen Qingyuan's heart and eyes were filled with the prince Xiao Jingyu. She trusted Liu's mother and daughter in everything, and often acted recklessly, which made him worry and worry a lot. But in just a few days, the girl acted calmly and thoughtfully, and she made several plans to dismantle the back house. Even the most prestigious old lady in the house favored her in everything.

    Xiao Yuci held the celadon tea cup with his fingertips, and white steam rose from the tea soup in the cup. He looked calm and responded casually: "It is really rare for a boudoir woman to wake up and restrain her mind."

    This short compliment pierced Mrs. Liu's heart. She sat at the end of the table, tightly twisting the brocade handkerchief she carried with her on her fingertips, trying to hold on to a gentle and decent smile on her face, but deep down she was already panicking. The power of the regent was in power, and his casual comment raised Shen Qingyuan's worth. In the future, if she wanted to secretly make things difficult for her legitimate daughter, she would inevitably have another layer of constraints.

    The old lady saw Liu's anxious expression, took a slow sip of tea, and then changed the subject to talk about the recent banquet of the Jingli family. She turned to look at Shen Qingyuan beside her and spoke calmly: "In three days, there will be the Begonia Banquet at Pingninghou Mansion. You should prepare your clothes and go to the banquet. During the banquet, you can get to know a few noble ladies from the aristocratic families and broaden your contacts."

    Mrs. Liu's eyes moved when she heard this, and she immediately stood up and begged softly: "Old madam, Qingrou was frightened a few days ago. She has been resting in the hospital for days and is feeling depressed. Why don't we let her go with Qing Yuan?" The banquet can not only relax, but also help my sister take care of trivial matters." She had a wishful thinking in her mind. As long as Shen Qingrou attends the Haitang Banquet, she can wait for an opportunity to meet the prince and frame Shen Qingyuan according to the original plan.

    Shen Qingyuan's eyebrows were light and he replied unhurriedly: "Of course I know that my aunt cares about my sister. It's just that my concubine is weak and she almost fainted in the garden just now. There are so many guests from the Marquis Mansion and they are traveling so much that if she catches the wind and cold, the gain will not be worth the loss. Moreover, the invitation from the Marquis Mansion was only sent to me, the legitimate daughter, and she rushed to the door without an invitation. Instead, she got rude gossip from the Prime Minister's Mansion."

    These few words were well-founded and made Liu speechless. Shen Qingrou stood aside, her eyes suddenly reddening, and she clenched her clothes tightly in grievance. Due to the presence of the regent, she did not dare to cry or act up, so she could only swallow her frustration silently.

    Xiao Yuci watched the game in the back house with cold eyes. He cast his penetrating gaze on the calm and composed Shen Qingyuan and said suddenly: "I have always been on good terms with Marquis Pingning. We are going to visit you three days ago to discuss matters. If Qingyuan goes to the banquet, she can just take her with me on my carriage and horse."

    As soon as the words fell to the ground, the whole hall fell into silence. Shen Jingshan was surprised and happy, and thanked him repeatedly. Liu's face instantly turned pale. The banquet trap he had finally planned almost failed because of the regent's words.

    After a moment of chatting, Xiao Yuci stood up to say goodbye, and Shen Qingyuan was ordered to accompany her father to the door of the house. The evening breeze carried the fallen begonia flowers and fell to the ground, leaving the two of them alone. Xiao Yuci lowered his eyes and looked at the girl beside him, and his low voice sounded in the evening wind: "Today's help is not a coincidence. I don't want the disaster of burning my body in my previous life to happen again."

    Shen Qingyuan suddenly froze, and looked up in astonishment. Being buried in a sea of ​​fire in her previous life was a secret she kept alone. How could Xiao Yuci know about it? Before she could ask further questions, the man had already turned around, his black robe melting into the dusk.

    Returning to Tinglan Courtyard, Chuntao came quietly to report. As soon as Liu returned to the courtyard, she wrote a secret letter and sent her confidant to the East Palace secretly. Shen Qingyuan twisted the begonia petals that had fallen on her shoulders, and a chill grew in her eyes. Since Mrs. Liu and the prince were determined to take action at the Begonia Banquet, she would go with the flow and wait for her enemies to fall into their traps.
title_en: Chapter 8 Hidden secrets during the banquet and secret plans before the banquet
